dominant_strengths: Bold sans-serif headline has confident scale and tight tracking, anchoring the hero with clear typographic hierarchy
Showing the actual product UI as the hero visual is honest and reinforces Webflow's craft and capability
Cookie banner and nav respect the dark hero, maintaining a coherent surface treatment across overlays
dominant_weaknesses: Cookie modal sits awkwardly over the primary CTA cards, blocking the most important interaction in the fold
Dense product screenshot competes with marketing copy, splitting attention between two visual systems with no clear focal point
Logo wall at the bottom feels generic and disconnected, a default trust pattern rather than a designed moment
fix_priorities: Reposition cookie banner to a corner toast so it stops occluding the AI/Template/Blank cards
Increase contrast/separation between hero copy layer and embedded product screenshot via vignette or framing
Refine the three build-path cards with more distinctive iconography or previews instead of mini screenshots
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral product-shot impact leads, but behavioral clarity is undermined by the cookie overlay and reflective meaning is muted by generic growth-engine messaging.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads as a credible Webflow homepage scroll showing the editor and entry paths, but the obstructed CTAs and busy hero blunt its effectiveness.
